description: Virtual server in the cloud for running application workloads.

sections.title: General Settings
sections.description: Core identity, AMI, and instance size configuration

fields.label: Instance Type

options.label: t3.micro (2 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM - General Purpose)
t3.small (2 vCPU, 2 GiB RAM - General Purpose)
t3.medium (2 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM - General Purpose)
m6i.large (2 vCPU, 8 GiB RAM - Production General)
c6i.large (2 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM - Compute Optimized)

fields.why: Determines the CPU, memory, storage, and networking capacity of your virtual server.
fields.impact: Changing instance type requires an instance stop and start cycle, causing brief downtime.

fields.label: Amazon Machine Image (AMI) ID

validation.error_message: Must be a valid AMI ID starting with 'ami-' followed by hex characters.

fields.why: Provides the OS, application server, and applications required to launch your instance.
fields.impact: Changing the AMI forces replacement (destruction and re-creation) of the EC2 instance.

sections.title: Network & Security
sections.description: VPC Placement, IP addressing, and security groups

fields.label: Auto-assign Public IP
fields.why: Assigns a publicly routable IPv4 address directly to the instance's network interface.
fields.impact: Exposing instances directly to public IPs increases network attack surface. Private subnets with NAT gateways are preferred for production.
